What I Bring

Core Capabilities

◎
Lighting Mastery

Proven ability to shoot in any condition: blazing airport sunsets, dim museum interiors, overcast skies, and golden hour ruins, with consistent, compelling results.

◈
Post-Production Editing

Expert-level proficiency in color grading, contrast enhancement, saturation tuning, and touch-ups to deliver gallery-ready images every time.

◉
Candid & Action Shots

A trained eye for spontaneous moments, capturing the energy, emotion, and dynamism of live events as they unfold naturally.

◐
Composition & Detail

From sweeping panoramas to intimate close-ups, every frame is composed with intention. Leading lines, symmetry, layering, and perspective.

◑
Multi-Environment Range

Shot across five countries and multiple climate zones: rainforests, waterfalls, urban streets, and heritage sites, adaptable to any summit venue.

◒
Professional Communication

Skilled at working with event teams, understanding briefs quickly, and delivering organized, clearly labeled photo packages on time.

The Person Behind the Lens

Karthik Raj Sunder Raj

Dentist MS Health Informatics Photographer Data Enthusiast
"I see the world through two lenses: the precision of science and the soul of a photograph."
The Story

By profession, a dentist, trained to see detail others miss. By pursuit, a graduate student in Health Informatics, where data tells the stories that shape healthcare's future. And in every quiet moment in between, a photographer chasing light.

The Intersection

What unites dentistry, data, and photography is the same discipline: attention. Whether diagnosing a patient, analyzing a dataset, or framing a shot, Karthik brings a methodical eye and an instinct for what truly matters. The detail that changes everything.

The Craft

Photography isn't a side hobby. It's a language. From editing temples at golden hour to freezing a seagull mid-flight over open water, every image is composed with intention and refined in post until it feels exactly right.
